properties.name: search
properties.documentation: The search query string for advanced filtering.  We are using the [Apache Lucene](https://lucene.apache.org/) query syntax here.  Only lucene queries equivalent to exact matching and startsWith are supported. Also only AND conjunctions supported at the moment.  Please be aware that our filters are **case-insensitive**  Examples of supported lucene queries: + `name:MyEncoding1` - This searches for encodings with names that are equal to `myencoding1`  + `name:\"My Encoding\"` - This searches for encodings with names that are equal to `my encoding`  + `name:MyEncoding\\*` - This searches for encodings with names that are equal to `myencoding*` Please have a look at the [Lucene Documentation - Escaping Special Characters](https://lucene.apache.org/core/8_1_1/queryparser/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/classic/package-summary.html#Escaping_Special_Characters) section to see what characters have to be escaped.  + `name:test*` - This searches for encodings with names that start with `test`  + `name:test* AND labels:Customer1` - This searches for encodings with names starting with `test` and labels containing an entry that is equal to `customer1`  Available search fields: + `name`  + `labels`  Please be aware to send these queries url encoded.  If you provide fields or lucene queries that are not supported, it will result in an error response.

properties.name: integratedLoudness
properties.documentation: Set the targeted integrated loudness value. Range is from '-70.0' to '-5.0'. Default value is '-24.0'. Value is measured in LUFS (Loudness Units, referenced to Full Scale)

properties.name: loudnessRange
properties.documentation: Set the targeted loudness range target. Range is from '1.0' to '20.0'. Default value is '7.0'. Loudness range measures the variation of loudness on a macroscopic time-scale in units of LU (Loudness Units). For programmes shorter than 1 minute, the use of the measure Loudness Range is not recommended due to too few data points (Loudness Range is based on the Short-term-Loudness values (3-seconds-window)).

properties.name: maximumTruePeakLevel
properties.documentation: Set maximum true peak. Range is from '-9.0' to '0.0'. Default value is '-2.0'. Values are measured in dBTP (db True Peak)

properties.documentation: After the encoding has been started, this will contain the cloud region that was actually used. This will differ from cloudRegion if cloudRegion was set to an unspecific region (e.g. 'AUTO')

properties.name: selectedEncoderVersion
properties.documentation: After the encoding has been started, this will contain the encoder version that was actually used. Especially useful when starting an encoding with a version tag like STABLE or BETA.

properties.name: selectedEncodingMode
properties.documentation: After the encoding has been started, this will contain the encoding mode that was actually used. Especially useful when `encodingMode` was not set explicitly or set to STANDARD (which translates to one of the other possible values on encoding start).

properties.name: selectedFallbackCloudRegions
properties.documentation: After the encoding has been started, this will contain the fallback cloud regions that were actually used. This will differ from fallbackCloudRegions if any of the fallbackCloudRegions were set to an unspecific region (e.g. 'AUTO')

properties.name: matchTime
properties.documentation: ISO 8601 date-time specifying when the signal should be matched and inserted into the live stream

properties.name: signals
properties.documentation: Array of ESAM signals containing SCTE-35 binary data. At least one signal is required (required)

properties.name: acquisitionPointIdentity
properties.documentation: A unique identifier representing the `Acquisition Point Identity` defined in the ESAM specification.

properties.name: adAvailOffset
properties.documentation: Defines an offset (in milliseconds) to be applied to the stream event timestamp. This offset adjusts the `StreamTime` values (such as PTS) associated with ad opportunities or content insertions. It is used to fine-tune timing for embedded SCTE-104/35 messages to ensure precise frame alignment in the transport stream.

properties.name: poisEndpoint
properties.documentation: The URL of the Placement Opportunity Information System (POIS) signal processing endpoint. The encoder transmits SignalProcessingEvents to this endpoint whenever SCTE-35 messages are detected.

properties.name: poisEndpointCredentials
properties.documentation: If authentication is required to access the POIS endpoint, credentials must be provided.

properties.name: zoneIdentity
properties.documentation: Specifies the `Zone Identity` defined in the ESAM specification.

properties.name: binary
properties.documentation: Base64-encoded SCTE-35 binary data to be inserted into the stream (required)

properties.name: offset
properties.documentation: The offset from the matched signal in ISO 8601 duration format, accurate to milliseconds
